_comment: DEMO: a plain-English rule. The gate_question below goes to TrueSight verbatim — change that one sentence and the system detects what YOU said, judged by the vision model on the live frames. Trigger: any person lingering in the zone named 'demo_floor' for 5s (draw it in Configure > Cameras > Draw a zone, name it demo_floor). The baseline critical rules stay merged underneath as always.

rules.title: CUSTOM RULE MATCHED
rules.gate_question: Is a person in these frames holding a phone above their head? Answer yes only if the phone is clearly raised above head height.
